svg.title: Brood Keeper R3 hurt: 9 explicit articulated poses
svg.desc: Self-contained new editable semantic vectors. Accepted11 key geometry retained; four short gold supports, broad rounded olive body, attached cream face and five raised hive ports. Fixed original crops, margins, reference registration and source_index; transparent overlapping source bands. No masks, baked annulus, spawn, projectile, socket or runtime edits.
